statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent episodes of syncope
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
Diagnosis codes I47.1 and R55 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is clinically indicated
The service is needed to correlate symptomatic events with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances
The service is needed to provide comprehensive evaluation of cardiac rhythm
